info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Institution Login Form-spec
info.description: The Institution Login Form Management API allows authorized users to create customized login forms for specific institutions. This endpoint facilitates the configuration of form elements tailored to institutional requirements, thus enhancing user experience during the authentication process. Typical consumers include educational institutions and administrative applications aiming to streamline access for their users. Through effective management of login forms, institutions can ensure their branding and user interface meet organizational standards.

post.summary: Create a new login form for the specific institution.
post.description: This endpoint allows the creation of a new login form associated with the institution identified by the specified resource ID. Use this operation to enable user authentication processes for the institution.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit login form data for the specified institution (RES-100045). It requires user credentials and possibly other authentication-related information to successfully log in.

201.description: Resource successfully created, indicating a new login form has been generated.
